action_visual: on the third day Su Nian has already prepared Gu Shen's americano before he sits down
source_text: 顾深第三天来，苏念已经把他的美式准备好了。你记得我喝什么

action_visual: Su Nian lies that he is a regular, hiding that she read his mind before he even drank
source_text: 常客。她在撒谎。她只是读了他的心

action_visual: Gu Shen drinks half the cup then stands to take a phone call, leaving the steaming cup on the counter
source_text: 顾深喝了半杯，起身去接电话。杯子留在吧台上

action_visual: Su Nian picks up the cup and closes her eyes

the world falls silent; instead of a voice, images flicker like old film frames — a girl standing in the rain, hair plastered to her face, clutching a key, crying, facing a young man inside a doorway who does not step out to chase her
source_text: 画面——一个女孩站在雨里，攥着钥匙，在哭。为什么你不出来追我

action_visual: Su Nian opens her eyes to find herself crying — not her own tears but the girl's from the vision — tears sliding down onto the counter
source_text: 苏念睁开眼，发现自己在流泪。泪水滴在吧台上

action_visual: Su Nian looks at her hands; the burn scar on her left ring finger remains, but on her right ring finger the faint white ring-mark from a silver ring given by her grandmother is gone
focus_object: bare right ring finger where the ring mark vanished
source_text: 右手无名指上的戒指印——消失了。外婆给的银戒指

action_visual: Gu Shen returns, sees the tear tracks on Su Nian's face and frowns
source_text: 顾深回来了。他看着苏念脸上的泪痕，皱了皱眉。你还好吗

action_visual: Su Nian wipes her tears and offers a fresh cup; Gu Shen downs the cold half-cup in one go and leaves
spoken_dialogue: 咖啡凉了，我给你换一杯。
source_text: 没事。咖啡凉了，我给你换一杯。不用。他一饮而尽，走了

action_visual: Su Nian stands behind the empty counter looking at her two hands, cataloguing which scars remain and which have vanished, realizing she is losing memories
source_text: 苏念站在吧台后面，看着自己的双手。她在失去记忆

action_visual: a sharp screech of brakes outside; Su Nian whips her head around to see a delivery motorbike skid to a stop at the door then vanish down the alley, the residue in the cup rippling
source_text: 窗外传来一声刹车声。外卖摩托车急停。杯里的残液荡出一道涟漪
